description: Election Commission - Notice declaring the names of the members elected for the Local Authorities in addition to the names published in the Gaz. Ex. No. 2061/42 of 09.08.2018
reasoning: This gazette notice announces election results for local authorities, specifically declaring the names of elected members for each ward and the members returned for the Local Authority. It falls under the Elections category as it deals with electoral processes and results declarations, published by the Elections Commission under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
